rule: Keep the unique largest 8-connected non-background group (the diagonal figure) and erase all other non-zero cells. Exactly one erased noise pixel occupies a grid corner. In that corner, draw a filled right triangle whose legs run along the two edges. The leg length equals the number of non-corner noise pixels, and the colour is their strict most frequent colour; the marker colour is not counted.
scope: Largest 8-connected diagonal figure preserved while scattered noise cells specify a corner triangle: individual non-corner pixel count sets leg length, strict colour mode sets fill, and exactly one occupied corner specifies direction. Random connected strokes scale to roughly 5–12.5% of larger grid area; dimensions 6..30, noise count 1..9. All five canonical examples reconstructed from explicit coordinates.

authored_scope: Random scenes: black background; sides 6..20 by default and 6..30 via controls (above 15 is a synthetic extension); any of the four corners; leg length 1..min(9, side-3), 2.. by default. The figure is a stroke-grown diagonal figure of 5..16 cells. Noise colours have a strict mode. Optional touching noise pairs can be orthogonal or diagonal. Hard cases cover noise sharing the figure colour, a marker equal to the mode, and a marker equal to a runner-up. Explicit scenes (sides 1..30) reconstruct the fixtures and are checked only for well-definedness. Not supported: non-black backgrounds; legs above 9 or above side-3 in random mode; noise touching the figure or the marker; more than one touching noise pair.
authored_constraints: Exactly one corner cell is non-background, and it holds the marker.
The figure is the strictly largest 8-connected non-background component.
The non-corner noise colours have a strict mode.
The triangle never overlaps the figure.
The background (0) is the strict plurality colour.
Leg n <= min(width, height); in random mode n <= min(width, height) - 3.
Random noise is kept outside the 8-neighbourhood of the figure and of the marker.
At most one touching noise pair, either orthogonal or diagonal.
Bool and non-integer controls are rejected with ValueError.
